content:
omar: FYI I started onboarding atlas9b (mistral-variant) today. conversion to runtime yields small perplexity bump after int4 quant but more concerning is trace we saw: attention patterns show phase drift after 512 tokens. looks like rotary wrapping.

qiao: can you attach attention vis snapshot?

devops-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-temp/atlas9b/attn-snapshots/shot_2026-03-20.png

omar: snapshot shows attention heads with periodic phase inversion every 128 tokens in some heads, others look fine. fp16 doesn't show this. int4 shows clear phase discontinuities at multiples of 128.

sora: that screams head-granular rotary stride mismatch. did conversion assume global rotary_freq while model uses per-head frequency scaling?

omar: converter logs: "rotary_freq: 1.0, per_head_rotary: false". original model config contains "per_head_freq_scale": true and a list of head_scales.

lee: aha. when per-head scaling is present but not exported, some heads get effectively frequency-saturated after quant noise. int4 reduces dynamic range so mis-scaled sin/cos embeddings lead to aliasing/wrap.

qiao: quick test: re-export with `--export-per-head-rotary` and include the head scales baked into the onnx as constants. ran 20-step generation: phase discontinuity eliminated and perplexity delta reduced from +0.9 -> +0.2.

omar: thanks. two action items: converter should detect `per_head_freq_scale` in config and automatically export head constants; and add a regression test reproducing the 128-token wrap pattern.

sora: i'll add a small unit test in runtime that runs a deterministic sequence and checks for phase continuity across context windows for each head (threshold on cross-correlation).

devops-bot: created issue RW-ONB-332: "Export per-head rotary scales when present in model config" and assigned to @qiao.

lee: note for performance: exporting extra head constants increases model size slightly but keeps runtime ops cheap. prefer correctness over tiny size wins for now. mark as P1.

omar: cool. re-run eval-suite after qiao's patch and we should be able to onboard atlas9b. linking attn snapshot and before/after logs in the issue.

qiao: PR ready for review: https://git.internal/rw/convert/pull/489 (adds per-head rotor export and CI test). cc @sora @lee.

omar: great work team, that one had me stumped for a bit. :relieved:
